title: capability-pack/v1 document
description: Canonical capability-pack/v1 descriptor: one versioned, schema-bound unit of shared gate behavior that tenants declare through the extends list of the quality-gate configuration seam. Provisioning is always a digest-verified recipe, and gate names are always prefixed by the capability. A pack without per-root gates may omit the discovery surface; the engine-bound signature verifier bootstrap pack is the single documented form that omits the gates surface, because its proof runs inside provisioning. A pack may declare minEngineVersion: the minimum engine version whose machinery its declared gates require, including the execution environment they assume; a tenant whose pinned engine predates the declared level or carries no compatibility proof entry for the pack major fails closed at gate-plan resolution.

environment.description: Environment enforced for the pack's provisioning and gates.

artifacts.description: Release artifacts keyed by <goos>-<goarch>, each digest-bound.

signature.description: The signature reference where the publisher signs the artifact.

discovery.description: How the pack finds its per-root work. A pack without per-root gates omits this surface; the executable validator rejects a per-root gate without it.

fileGlob.description: The glob whose parent directories form the per-root set.

assertions.description: Fail-closed environment proofs executed before any pack gate.

expect.description: The output proof the assertion requires.

gates.description: The pack's gates; every name is lowercase kebab prefixed by the capability. A present gates field binds at least one gate; the engine-bound signature verifier bootstrap pack is the single documented form that omits the field entirely.

timeout.description: An optional positive Go duration such as 5m.

minEngineVersion.description: The optional minimum engine version whose machinery the pack's declared gates require, including the execution environment they assume — a pinned three-part engine version such as 1.1.0. When present, a tenant whose pinned engine predates the declared level, or whose pinned engine carries no compatibility proof entry for this pack major, fails closed at gate-plan resolution: the pack's declared form never degrades into a local re-implementation on an older engine and never executes unproven.
